task_fulfillment.rationale: Exactly three files of the required types are supplied, with blank event fields, an empty tracker, source-required columns and correct governing budget authority. Material corrections remain: the form lacks the required four-category multi-select, escalation relies on an undefined authority, and the form treats the proposed Change ID format as settled while the SOP and tracker say it awaits confirmation. Storage and retention dependencies are appropriately disclosed for a draft. Rendering and human acceptance were not verified.
